==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world, there exists giant monsters known as Jinxes. My job is to collect information on and slay these beasts. The first Jinx I encounter and battle, is revealed to be a normal human who was transformed into a mindless giant.

The second Jinx I encounter and battle, is revealed to be a red ant that was transformed into a giant. Unlike the human, the ant seems to still have its mind intact. When the ant dies, it releases an aura of sadness that can be felt by everyone in the area.

I meet a short woman with blue eyes, a brown pixie cut hairstyle, a jacket made of brown fur, and green camo pants. The woman tells me that if she had the power, that she would bring justice to the world like she does in her favorite videogame. I check out the game for any clues it might have regarding the Jinxes, but the game is in another language that I only partially understand.

I have a feeling that the Jinxes are being magically created by someone, but I don't know why. All I know for sure is that the Jinxes are made against their will and that they don't actually want to hurt anyone. I wake up before I can find the mastermind responsible for creating the Jinxes.
